name: ETL AI Automation with loops n conditions

parameters.text:
=TASK: Clean and normalize the raw student dataset provided in the <RAW_DATA> block below.

IMPORTANT:
- Process ONLY the actual records provided. Do not hallucinate dummy examples (no John Doe/Jane Smith unless present in the input).
- Return ONLY a valid JSON array of objects. No markdown formatting, no ```json code fences, no extra text.

RULES:
1. Deduplication: Drop completely empty objects and exact duplicate records.
2. Whitespace: Trim leading, trailing, and excessive spaces across all fields.
3. Student_ID: Retain original value.
4. Name, Course, City: Convert to Title Case. If missing, null, or blank, use "Unknown".
5. Email: Lowercase string. If missing, null, or invalid, use "unknown@example.com".
6. Phone: Strip spaces, hyphens, and brackets. Keep digits and optional leading '+'. If missing, null, or blank, use "Not Available".
7. Fee_Paid: Output strictly as "Yes" or "No":
   - "yes", "paid", 1, true, "true" -> "Yes"
   - "no", "unpaid", 0, false, "false", null, empty, missing, or invalid -> "No"
8. Enrolled_Date: Format valid dates as "YYYY-MM-DD". If missing, null, or unparseable, use "1970-01-01".

<RAW_DATA>
{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}
</RAW_DATA>
